local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died surveying original carried Song')
 local inv=types.Actor.inventory(self)
 for _,o in ipairs(nearby.items) do if o.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x24569) then print('SongBaseline nearby='..o.id..' legacyWorldBook='..tostring(types.Book.objectIsInstance(o))) end end
 print('SongInventory stock='..inv:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x24569))..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
 for _,obj in ipairs(inv:getAll()) do if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x24569) then
  assert(types.Book.objectIsInstance(obj),'Carried Song facade changed')
  local rec=types.Book.record(obj);assert(rec.name=='A Less Rude Song' and rec.value==6 and rec.weight==0.5,'Original Song inventory properties changed')
  print('SongInventory original properties value=6 weight=0.5')
 end end
end}}}}
